title: 蝙蝠在黑里怎么飞 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen lines with light transparent watercolour washes and visible grain, dusk blue, soft violet and warm cream

pages.scene: One single bat in flight seen from below, its wings stretched out flat to both sides and its thin finger bones showing through the thin skin, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it.
